show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/B8bL55
show.description: When a grief-stricken prince and his street-smart lookalike accidentally swap lives, their playful escape spirals into a deadly conspiracy — forcing the two unlikely brothers-in-spirit to outwit murderous royals, reclaim a stolen throne, and redefine what it truly means to wear the crown… or survive without one.
